description: This file defines API routes for tracking functionalities within a food delivery platform, including listing tracking events, publishing new tracking events, and real-time WebSocket updates for order tracking.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance configured for tracking endpoints

methods.name: None _assert_order_access(session: AsyncSession, user: AuthUser, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access a specific order, raising HTTPException if access is denied.

methods.name: List[TrackingEventOut] list_tracking_events( order_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tracking events for a specific order, enforcing proper access control.

methods.name: dict publish_tracking_event( order_id: UUID, payload: TrackingPublishRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Allows authorized users to publish a new tracking event for an order, triggering websocket updates.

methods.name: None order_tracking_ws(websocket: WebSocket, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connections for real-time order tracking updates.

ctags.name: _assert_order_access
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_order_access(session: AsyncSession, user: AuthUser, order_id: UUID) -> None:$/

ctags.name: list_tracking_events
ctags.signature: ( order_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )

ctags.name: order_tracking_ws
ctags.pattern: /^async def order_tracking_ws(websocket: WebSocket, order_id: UUID) -> None:$/

ctags.name: publish_tracking_event
ctags.signature: ( order_id: UUID, payload: TrackingPublishRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
